name: opening_drive_post_gap_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-fast
thesis: The first 5-10 minutes after a gap open often exhibit a 'drive' — a strong directional move that either extends or reverses the gap — driven by the collision of pre-market orders, stop-loss triggers, and institutional VWAP algorithms starting their execution. When the opening drive direction is the SAME as the gap direction with heavy volume, it signals genuine institutional conviction and the move tends to continue for 20-40 more minutes. This strategy buys the opening drive momentum after confirming the first 5-minute bar closes in gap direction with 2x+ volume. The inefficiency exists because the opening drive window is extremely short and most traders are still assessing the market, missing the initial momentum burst.
stock_filter: gap > 0.3% (abs); opening 5-min bar closes in gap direction; volume > 2x avg first-5-min
session: 09:15-11:00 IST (opening drive is a morning-only phenomenon)
indicators: drive_alignment = drive_direction * sign(gap_pct)  # +1 if aligned, -1 if counter
bar_body_ratio = abs(close - open) / (high - low + 0.01)  # candle body vs range

conditions: drive_alignment > 0 (drive in same direction as gap)
time == 09:20 IST (enter at close of 5th 1-min bar)
long.confirmation: first_5min_close > open AND close in upper 25% of first_5min_range

short.confirmation: first_5min_close < open AND close in lower 25% of first_5min_range

entry.entry_price: market order immediately after 5th 1-min bar closes

exit.target: 0.5% move from entry in drive direction
exit.stop_loss: price reverses to opposite end of first_5min_range OR 0.5 * ATR_10
exit.trailing_stop: after 0.2% gain, trail stop at 0.1% below entry (lock in partial profit)
exit.time_stop: exit if held > 40 mins (opening drive fades quickly)
exit.signal_exit: if price crosses below EMA_5 against position direction, exit (momentum lost)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX > 12 AND VIX < 25 (need volatility for drive, but not chaos)
filters.time_filter: only enter at 09:20 IST (5th minute close); no second entries
filters.trend_filter: NIFTY 50 opening drive in same direction (macro alignment)
filters.spread_filter: bid-ask < 0.05% by minute 5 (spread should have normalized from open)
filters.event_filter: skip if opening drive caused by stock circuit (5/10/20% band hit)

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — opening drive dynamics are structural (institutional order flow at open) and robust across markets

weaknesses: The 5-minute wait means entering after the initial burst; on strong drive days the best 0.3-0.5% move may already be done, leaving little follow-through
Opening 5-minute volume can be inflated by matching of pre-open orders, making the 2x volume filter less meaningful than it appears
When multiple stocks qualify simultaneously (broad market gap), selecting the best candidate requires ranking logic not specified here, reducing edge per trade
prior_art: Crabel (1990) 'Opening Range Breakout'; Schulmeister (2009) on opening price dynamics. Opening drive concept from Fisher (2002) 'The Logical Trader'.
notes: Edge math: 0.55 * 50bps - 0.45 * 25bps = 27.5 - 11.25 = 16.25bps gross. Costs ~9bps RT. Net ~7.25bps/trade * 2 trades = ~14.5bps daily. The 28bps estimate includes occasional strong drive days with 80+ bps continuation. Strictly morning-only strategy with high capital efficiency due to short hold times.
